info.name: Alaba Marketplace API v1.0
info.description: Complete Postman collection for Alaba Marketplace API with all endpoints, authentication, and comprehensive documentation.

item.name: 🔒 Admin
item.description: Admin-only endpoints for system management and user administration

request.description:
Get all users - paginated results (admin only)
Query Parameters:
- page: Page number (default: 1)
- take: Items per page (default: 10)

Get specific user details (admin only)
Path Parameters:
- id: User ID to retrieve

Reactivate deactivated user (admin only)
Path Parameters:
- id: User ID to reactivate
Get admin store dashboard data with analytics and insights

item.name: Authentication
item.description: User authentication and token management endpoints

request.description: Create a new user account with email, phone, and password
Login with email and password to receive JWT token
Request password reset link via email or phone
Reset password using the token sent to email or phone
Check if email address is already registered
Check if phone number is already registered
Verify email address using token from email link
Request email verification (sends verification email to user)
Refresh access token using refresh token

item.name: 👤 User Management
item.description: User profile and account management endpoints

request.description: Get all users (admin only) - paginated results
Refresh current user details from database
Check if user exists by email or phone
Update user first and last name
Add password for users without one (OAuth sign-ups)
Check if user has an associated store
Get products for the authenticated seller store (redirects to product_search/single)
Get products for a specific store (admin)
Get product details for seller/admin (edit view)
Bulk upload products via Excel file (seller/admin)
Check if products belong to the same store (public)
Get all orders for current user
Get a single order for current user
Get a single order for seller
